description: Election Commission - Declare that V. Gnanenthiran and Y. A. Sauntharanathan as members of the Nallur Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Nallur Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill positions vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related matters rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
